Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vikas Pande, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned Deputy Advocate General 
for the State.
3. Petitioner has filed an impleadment application (IA 
No.2/2026) for impleading “General Manager, 
Rehabilitation, Tehri Hydro Development Corporation, 
Tehri Garhwal,” as respondent no.2 to the writ petition.
4. Since the impleadment is formal in nature, 
therefore, it is not being opposed by learned State 
Counsel.
5. Accordingly, impleadment application is allowed.
6. Let necessary amendment be incorporated by the 
petitioner in the memo of parties during the course of the 
day.
7. List on 22.04.2026 as fresh.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
